notes.title: 10th Anniversary Special: Playable Art Summons: Lithe
notes.content:
[b]Available: 9/17 16:00 - 9/30 15:59 JST[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/c901db7b1c03d3c10ac77728fda6fb6ce839124f.png[/img]

Creator's Art Collaboration version characters are being introduced for a limited time!

The draw rate for ★5 characters in this Summons is 6%. The x10 Summons guarantees one ★5 character every five Steps, except for Steps 20 and 40.

Get your hands on 10th Anniversary Exchange Medal (September) at all Steps and a Choose a New ★5 Character Summons Ticket (Lithe) at Steps 20 and 40!

The Choose a New ★5 Character Summons Ticket (Lithe) allows you to choose which one of the below characters you will receive.

Characters
Rukia (Creator's Art Collaboration version)
Orihime (Creator's Art Collaboration version)

Check out the characters' abilities on the official Brave Souls YouTube channel!
[previewyoutube=lwpezEzQYoI;full][/previewyoutube]

See below for details.

[h2]Character Details: Rukia[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Melee normal attack
- Strong attack 2: Boost and heal
- Strong attack 3: Barrier
- All attacks except strong attack 2 and 3: Drain+
- Human Killer+
- EX Skill: EX (Team/Party) Increased Normal Attack Damage +20%
- Soul Trait: Normal Attack Damage +35%
- Enemies Defeated Bonus: "(Team/Party) Damage to Status Ailment-Affected Enemies +20%" at 40
- Skill: Paralysis Resistance 200%

[b]・Character Details[/b]
Rukia can inflict Drain+ with all of her attacks apart from her second and third strong attacks, allowing her to steal her enemies' Stamina for herself while sealing away their ability to inflict status ailments. As a "+" type status ailment, Drain+ can be stacked with other status ailments, maximizing their impact.

With her EX Skill "EX (Team/Party) Normal Attack Damage +20%" supported by a Soul Trait, skills, and an Enemies Defeated Bonus that also increase her normal attack damage, Rukia can receive a normal attack damage boost of up to 145%.

Her second strong attack can both Boost and heal, meaning she increases the damage output of herself and her allies while replenishing everyone's Stamina. Plus, she also has a barrier on her third strong attack and the skill "Multi-Barrier +2," allowing her to protect her allies with multiple barriers.

She also has the team-boosting Enemies Defeated Bonus "(Team/Party) Damage to Status Ailment-Afflicted Enemies +20%" which activates after defeating 40 enemies. When combined with her Boost techniques, this can deal immense damage.

On top of the Soul Trait "Normal attack damage +35%," she can share the EX Skill "EX (Team/Party) Normal Attack Damage +20%" if she is used in the first link slot. This makes her highly effective as a character link for normal attack-focused characters.

Rukia has Human Killer+, which when combined with the Innate Skill "Dodge Human Damage 50%," and Paralysis Resistance 200% ensures that she shines as a non-controlled character in Guild Quests with Human Killer and increased melee damage rules.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/78df20a7574361f42b3509b240fd4a5f7863cbdf.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=7w0ANu8joU0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Character Details: Orihime[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Ranged normal attack
- Strong attack 1: Minor boost
- Strong attack 3: Heal
- Special Move: barrier and heal
- All attacks except strong attack 1 and 3: Lacerate+
- No Affiliation Killer+
- Soul Trait: Decreased Damage Taken 20%
- EX Skill: EX Bruiser +30%
- Enemies Defeated Bonus: "(Team/Party) Special Move Damage +20%" at 20
- Enemies Defeated Bonus: "(Team/Party) Damage to Status Ailment-Affected Enemies +20%" at 40
- Skill: Flurry in Guild Quests +3

[b]・Character Details[/b]
Orihime can inflict Lacerate+ with all of her attacks apart from her first and third strong attacks, allowing her to prevent her enemies from using their strong attacks while dealing continuous damage. As a "+" type status ailment, Lacerate+ can be stacked with other status ailments, maximizing the impact of status effects.

Her first strong attack has a minor boost effect for her allies that is amplified by "Booster" and "Enhancer," which prolongs the effects for the same length as the strong attack's cooldown time, meaning she can keep the boost applied the entire time she is fighting. Plus, with the healing effect of her third strong attack and the skills "Medic" and "Healer," she can restore Stamina, making her excellent in support roles.

She also has the team-boosting Enemies Defeated Bonuses "(Team/Party) Special Move Damage +20%," which activates after defeating 20 enemies and "(Team/Party) Damage to Status Ailment-Afflicted Enemies +20%," which activates after defeating 40.

On top of the Soul Trait "Damage taken -20%," she can share the EX Skill "EX Bruiser +30%" if she is used in the first link slot. This makes her highly effective as a character link for normal attack-focused characters.

Orihime also has a variety of skills that enhance her performance in Guild Quests, such as "Flurry +3 in Guild Quests" and No Affiliation Killer+. These help to ensure she shines as a non-controlled character in these quests, especially those with No Affiliation Killer and increased ranged damage rules.

[previewyoutube=PWsc7r2LDbA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Character Details: Ninny[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Melee strong attack
- Strong attack 2: superior strong attack
- All attacks: Paralysis+
- EX Move: Forward-Facing Wide-Range Attack
- Arrancar Killer+
- EX Skills: "EX Strong Attack Recharge Time -12%" and "EX Devastation +30%"
- Skill: Frenzy +3
- Skill: Damage to Paralyzed enemies +50%
- Skill: (Team/Party) Strong Attack Damage +20%
- Skill: Damage inflicted at full STA +30%
- Skill: Freeze Resistance 200%

[b]・Character Details[/b]
Ninny can inflict Paralysis+ with all of her attacks, allowing her to stop her enemies in their tracks and take the advantage in battle. As a "+" type status ailment, Paralysis+ can be stacked with other status ailments, maximizing their impact.

She also has the extremely powerful "Frenzy +3" as well as "(Team/Party) Strong Attack Damage +20%" to boost her and her allies' strong attack damage too. When her increased strong attack damage skills are combined with her Soul Trait, her strong attack damage is boosted by a formidable 85%.

Her second strong attack is a superior strong attack, meaning it deals more damage than a regular strong attack, and she can also unleash her EX Move "Forward-Facing Wide-Range Attack". This powerful attack has a wide range and deals immense damage.

With "Bombardment +1," the powerful "Full Stamina Damage Boost 30%," "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +80%," "Damage to Paralyzed Enemies +50%," "Weaken Defense," and the EX Skill "EX Devastation +30%" Ninny's Special Move can deal a devastating amount of damage.

Her Soul Trait "Strong attack damage +30%" and EX Skills "EX Strong Attack Recharge Time -12%" and "EX Devastation +30%" can be shared with other characters by placing her in their first link slot, making her an excellent choice for a character link.

With useful skills such as "Freeze Resistance 200%," which allows her to nullify even the Freeze+ status ailment, and the Innate Skill "Marauder," Ninny is well-suited to a wide range of quests.

She also has Arrancar Killer+ and can deal devastating damage with both her strong attacks and Special Move. This makes her immensely valuable in high-difficulty quests, such as Guild Quests, with Arrancar Killer and Increased Melee Damage rules.

Thanks to "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +80%," "EX Damage to Drained Enemies +40%," and "Damage to Drained Enemies +40%," she can deal crippling damage to enemies that she has inflicted with Drain+.

Her Soul Trait "Strong attack recharge time -14%" and EX Skill "EX Damage to Drained Enemies +40%" can be shared with other characters by placing her in their first link slot, making her an excellent choice for a character link.

With No Affiliation Killer+, "Freeze Resistance 200%" allowing her to nullify even the Freeze+ status ailment, "Poise Break (Except Brave Battles)" to go head-to-head against enemies with Poise, and "Frenzy +3 in Guild Quest," Noel shines in Guild Quests with No Affiliation Killer and increased ranged damage rules.

All of her attacks besides her first and third strong attack can inflict both Lacerate and Drain, allowing her to steal Stamina and deal continuous damage while preventing her enemies from inflicting status ailments and using strong attacks and Special Moves.

Macy's first strong attack has a minor boost effect for her allies that is amplified by "Booster" and "Enhancer," which prolongs the effects for the same length as the strong attack's cooldown time, meaning she can keep the boost applied the entire time she is fighting.

Her third strong attack has a major boost with a higher effect and longer duration than usual, greatly boosting both the offensive and defensive capabilities of herself and her allies.

On top of the Soul Trait "Damage inflicted at full STA +40%," she can share the EX Skill "EX Bruiser +30%" if she is used in the first link slot. This makes her highly effective as a character link for normal attack-focused characters.

Macy has No Affiliation Killer+ and "Fire Resistance 200%," which allows her to nullify even Burn+ stage hazards, meaning she shines as a non-controlled character in Guild Quests with No Affiliation Killer and Increased Melee Damage rules.

notes.content:
[b]Available: 7/31 16:00 - 8/15 15:59 JST[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/0e348f8f97925d8d9e0584b66e208d5b9e45711a.png[/img]

Three characters from the BLEACH TV Animation Series: Thousand-Year Blood War have been added!

The draw rate for ★5 characters in this Summons is 6%. The x10 Summons guarantees one ★5 character every five Steps, except for Steps 25 and 50.

Furthermore, you'll receive the Choose a New ★5 Character Summons Ticket (Manifestation) at Step 25.

The Choose a New ★5 Character Summons Ticket (Manifestation) allows you to choose which one of the below characters you will receive.

Characters
- Jushiro (Thousand-Year Blood War 2025 version)
- Renji (Thousand-Year Blood War 2025 version)
- Uryu (Thousand-Year Blood War 2025 version)

At Step 50, you'll receive the 10th Anniversary Choose a ★5 Character Summons Ticket (Manifestation).

The 10th Anniversary Choose a ★5 Character Summons Ticket (Manifestation) allows you to choose one of the Thousand-Year Blood War characters that appeared up to July 31, 2024, including the newly introduced characters.

Check out the characters' abilities on the official Brave Souls YouTube channel!
[previewyoutube=EOsKBmRsHwk;full][/previewyoutube]

See below for details.

[h2]Character Details: Jushiro[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Ranged strong attack
- Strong attack 2: superior strong attack
- Special Move: Insta-kill chance
- All attacks: Paralysis+
- EX Move: Super homing vortex
- Arrancar Killer+
- EX Skill: Berserker +30%
- Skill: Frenzy +3
- Skill: Damage to Paralyzed enemies +80%
- Skill: (Team/Party) Strong Attack Recharge 10%
- Skill: All Status Ailments Resistance 200%

[b]・Character Details[/b]
Jushiro can inflict Paralysis+ with all of his attacks, allowing him to stop his enemies in their tracks and take the advantage in battle. As a "+" type status ailment, Paralysis+ can be stacked with other status ailments, maximizing their impact.

He has the extremely powerful "Frenzy +3" and "Berserker +80%," enabling him to deal massive damage with his strong attacks. Additionally, Jushiro possesses the new EX Skill "EX Berserker +30%," which further boosts his strong attack damage.

His second strong attack is a superior strong attack that deals greater damage than standard ones. He can also utilize the EX Move "Super homing vortex" to automatically track enemies and unleash wide-area attacks. With its high hit count, his second strong attack is exceptional at inflicting status ailments on enemies.

With "Bombardment +1" and powerful skills such as "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +100%," "Damage to Paralyzed Enemies +80%," and "Weaken Defense" Jushiro can deal devastating damage with his Special Move.

His Soul Trait "Strong attack recharge time -14%" and EX Skill "EX Berserker +30%" can be shared with other characters by placing him in their first link slot, making him an excellent choice for a character link.

Available for the first time as a skill, Jushiro has "(Team/Party) Strong Attack Recharge 10%." He boasts the ability to nullify even "+" type status ailments with "All Status Ailment Resistances 200%" and possesses other useful skills such as "Long Stride" and the Innate Skill "Sharpshooter," allowing him to navigate various quests with ease.

Equipped with Arrancar Killer+ and the ability to deal significant damage with his strong attacks and Special Move, Jushiro shines in high-difficulty quests like Guild Quests with Arrancar Killer and increased ranged damage rules.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/52c7e890079eafede930f3f14a61f911e5d2ef81.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=05sWc4jWzLM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Character Details: Renji[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Ranged strong attack
- Strong attack 2: superior strong attack
- Strong attack 3: Two-stage charged attack
- Normal attack, strong attack 2, EX Move: Lacerate+
- Strong attack 1, strong attack 3, Special Move: Lacerate/Burn
- EX Move: Massive Spiritual Pressure Boost
- Quincy Killer+
- EX Skill: Damage to Lacerated Enemies +40%
- Skill: Frenzy +3
- Skill: (Soul Reaper Resonance) Strong Attack Damage +10%
- Skill: Poise Break (Except Brave Battles)
- Skill: Weaken Resistance 200%

[b]・Character Details[/b]
Renji can inflict Lacerate and Burn with his first and third strong attacks, as well as his Special Move. If successful, both status ailments will deal continuous damage to those inflicted as well as prevent them from using their strong attacks. As a "+" type status ailment, the Lacerate+ on his normal attack, second strong attack, and EX Move can also be stacked with other status ailments, maximizing their impact.

By inflicting Lacerate on enemies, Renji activates "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +80%". When this is combined with the powerful "Damage to Lacerated Enemies +80%," and the new EX Skill "EX Damage to Lacerated Enemies +40%," his damage output increases significantly.

Renji's EX Move "Massive Spiritual Pressure Boost" allows him to boost his Spiritual Pressure by 100% for 10 seconds. Unleashing this and then making use of his second strong attack, a superior strong attack, the two-stage charged attack on his third strong attack, and his Special Move can result in explosive damage.

With powerful skills like "Frenzy +3" and "Berserker +60%," Renji excels at dealing massive damage through his strong attacks. His Special Move also really packs a punch thanks to "Bombardment +1" and "Weaken Defense."

Renji's Soul Trait "Strong attack recharge time -14%" and the ability to share his EX Skill "EX Damage to Lacerated Enemies +40%" through the first character link slot make him an excellent link for characters who can inflict Lacerate.

With Quincy Killer+, "Weakness Resistance 200%" allowing him to nullify even the Weakness+ status ailment, and "Poise Break (Except Brave Battles)" to go head-to-head against enemies with Poise, Renji shines in high-difficulty content with Quincy Killer and increased ranged damage rules, such as Guild Quests and the Limit Breaker Quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/3231de16bfa6377e655ec258b5f1926c74e0ac1b.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=JVkIdZN2SV4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Character Details: Uryu[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Ranged normal attack
- Killer: Stern Ritter Killer/Soul Reaper Killer
- Soul Trait: Damage taken -21%
- EX Skill: Bruiser +30%
- Skill: Flurry +3
- New Skill: (Brave Battles Only) Opening Stat Boost
- New Skill: (Brave Battles Only) Block Boosts and Debuffs
- Skill: (Brave Battles Only) Persistence
- Skill: (Brave Battles Only) Persistence Breaker

[b]・Character Details[/b]
Uryu is exceptionally well-suited to Brave Battles, as he has defensive skills such as "Brave Battle Temporary Invincibility" and "(Brave Battles Only) Persistence" that grant him the staying power to withstand even the fiercest of attacks. Additionally, he also has "(Brave Battles Only) Persistence Breaker," "Ignore Brave Battle Invincibility," and "(Brave Battles Only) Prevent Last-Ditch Survival" to negate the defensive capabilities of his opponents.

Uryu has the newly introduced, "(Brave Battles Only) Opening Stat Boost", which enhances his Attack, Defense, and Focus stats for a limited time at the start of the battle. Combining this with the powerful, "(Brave Battles Only) Block Boosts and Debuffs" makes Uryu capable of stopping his enemies from both boosting themselves and debuffing him throughout the fight.

His Soul Trait of "Damage taken -21%" makes him a valuable option for first-slot character links as besides his Soul Trait he can also share his EX Skill "EX Bruiser +30%." This makes him highly effective as a character link for normal attack-focused characters.

In addition to his ability "Flurry +3," Uryu boasts "Bruiser +40%" and the EX Skill "EX Bruiser +30%" and has two killer effects: Stern Ritter Killer and Soul Reaper Killer. This means that he can go head-to-head with many characters in terms of raw firepower, making him a standout option for dealing heavy damage in a variety of different scenarios.

Additionally, his EX Move "Continuous Sweeping Attack" unleashes a super-powerful continuous attack centered around himself, striking a wide area for several seconds and delivering damage to surrounding enemies. This EX Move is not only powerful but also has a 50-second cooldown, allowing Ichigo to rack up high damage with a shorter turn-around.

He is the first character to possess the skill "Bombardment +2." Furthermore, Ichigo is equipped with other powerful skills, including "Full Stamina Damage Boost +50%," "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +100%," and "Weaken Defense." [h2]Character Details: Ichigo[/h2]
[b]・Characteristics[/b]
- Attack type: Melee strong attack

- New Soul Trait: (Team/Party) Strong Attack Damage +20% (max)
- Innate Skill: Complete Status Immunity
- Skill: Frenzy +2
- Skill: Bombardment +1
- Skill: Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +100%

[b]・Character Details[/b]
Ichigo has the "(Team/Party) Increased Strong Attack Damage +20%" Soul Trait that allows him to boost the strong attack damage of himself and his allies. This powerful boost can be shared by simply linking him with another character, allowing that character to make use of this Soul Trait. This makes him a great character to have in your arsenal. However, please be aware that if more than one character in the team has the same type of Team/Party boost, the effect will not stack.

He also has the skills "Frenzy +2" and "Bombardment +1," making both his strong attacks and Special Moves forces to be reckoned with. Furthermore, all of his attacks can inflict Weaken, which reduces enemies' damage output to one, so it's possible to reduce incoming damage while dealing heavy damage to your enemies. This pairs well with his skill "Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Hollows" and also allows him to deal further damage with the boost provided by the "Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost 100%" skill.

Ichigo has a number of convenient skills such as "Sprinter +3," "Long Stride," and "Marauder" that make him well-suited to a number of quest types, as well as the Innate Skill "Complete Status Immunity" to negate the effect of map hazards.

Due to his immense destructive power, Ichigo makes his presence known in the high-difficulty Limit-Breaker Quests and Guild Quests with the Hollow Killer rule.

Since all of Masaki’s attacks can inflict Paralysis, she can stop her enemies in their tracks while dealing damage. She has a greater chance of inflicting status ailments on Arrancars and the Espada already targeted by her Espada killer effect thanks to her skill "Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Arrancars." notes.title: 8th Anniversary Step-Up Summons
notes.content:
[b]Available: 7/23 16:00 - 7/31 15:59 JST[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/e2d556a4eb8adb29ffe7fced15061df5787819d3.png[/img]

To celebrate the 8th anniversary, we'll be adding the 8th Anniversary Step-Up Summons.

The 8th Anniversary x10 Step-Up Summons and the 8th Anniversary Step-Up Summons will both be available, and both are free to use the first time!

From Step 2 onward, each Step comes with extra bonus items, and Step 6 of the x10 Summons guarantees you one of the twelve featured ★5 characters.

There are seven Steps in total. The Steps do not reset, but you can use Step 7 as many times as you like.

This Summons features special 8th Anniversary versions of Ichigo and White!

The might of the inseparable, Ichigo Kurosaki.

Ichigo is a ranged strong attack character with the Hollow Killer and No Affiliation Killer skills.

All of his attacks can inflict both Weaken and Drain, and he has Frenzy +3, meaning his strong attacks can really pack a punch. In addition, his new skill "Poise Break (Except Brave Battles)" lets him tear through enemies on the battlefield.

His second strong attack gathers enemies together to hammer them with an attack, and then automatically ploughs through them with a homing vortex! Through Special Souls his Soul Trait can be powered up to Strong Attack Recharge Time -14%, letting him unleash strong attacks with increased frequency.

Thanks to powerful abilities and Innate Skills such Shared Complete Status Immunity, Sharpshooter, Hit Hidden Enemy Chance: 100%, and Read All Affiliation Dodges, Ichigo will come in useful in a variety of quests.

The source of black and white, White!

White is a melee strong attack character with the Soul Reaper Killer and No Affiliation Killer skills.

All of his attacks can inflict both Drain and Lacerate, and he has both Frenzy +2 and Bombardment +1, making him a destructive presence on the battlefield.

He also has the new skill "(Team/Party) Mind Attribute Character Special Move Damage +30%," which means even characters fighting with him get a damage boost when using Special Moves. This, combined with his ability to learn the Weaken Defense skill, makes him a force to be reckoned with when it comes to Special Moves!

Furthermore, he can make use of Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Heart Attribute Enemies and his multi-hit strong attack to inflict status ailments on enemies, and then through Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost +80%, Damage to Drained Enemies +40%, and Damage to Lacerated Enemies +60%, deal explosive damage to anyone unlucky enough to find themselves up against him.

While he is destroying enemies with status ailments, he himself is immune to them thanks to Complete Status Immunity 100%, making him useful in a variety of different quests.

He is the first character to have the skill Sprinter +3 and be able to acquire (Team/Party) Increased Mind Attribute Character Movement Speed +30%, meaning he can dart around the battlefield destroying his enemies.

See below for details of the Summons.

notes.title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Tie-In Campaign
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Bleach: Brave Souls!

We're implementing various campaigns to celebrate the release of the BLEACH TV Animation Series: Thousand-Year Blood War.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/eaee12ef938ce60fb4ce517c8921dbc1b5412f77.png[/img]

[h2]BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Tie-In Campaign Login Bonus[/h2]
Available: 10/1 00:00 - 10/30 23:59 JST
 
Log in every day for 20 days to receive a total of 100 Spirit Orbs!

You can see a list of forthcoming login bonuses by tapping the cogwheel icon in the top right of the Home screen and then tapping the Login Bonus button.

[h2]Free Thousand-Year Blood War Summons[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/25e4e24a8ea1cde68dd43fecef6267bfbeda749e.png[/img]

Available: 9/30 16:00 - 12/31 15:59 JST

The Thousand-Year Blood War PV Campaign currently running on various SNS platforms has passed 10,000 reactions, so for a limited time only, the Free Thousand-Year Blood War Summons will be available!

This Summons is available for free once per player and guarantees a ★5 character.

[h2]Free BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Brave Souls Summons[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/7991d75b8e01f156ee986690251a04f9cab1a45f.png[/img]

Available: 10/1 16:00 - 10/31 15:59 JST

A free x10 Summons will be available during the period shown above. One Step is available every day, and there are a maximum of ten Steps on offer. Step 10 guarantees a ★5 character!

[h2]Thousand-Year Blood War Step-Up Summons: Concord[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/7a85ff30407906897f2a7ca7e1180c053b6f29b6.png[/img]

Available: 9/30 16:00 - 10/31 15:59 JST

Three characters from the BLEACH TV Animation Series: Thousand-Year Blood War will be available!

The Thousand-Year Blood War Step-Up Summons: Concord comes in both single-pull and x10 types, and the first pull from both Summons is free! From Step 2 onward, each Step comes with extra bonus items, and Step 6 of the x10 Summons guarantees you one of the twelve featured ★5 characters.

[h2]Kon's School Newspaper[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/34c7a1fd64a4f6edafcc056fd16181b66a509a63.png[/img]

Available: 9/30 16:00 - 10/16 15:59 JST

Extra! Extra! Kon's School Newspaper, full of information gathered by Kon, is out now, and the first subject is exactly who you think it is!

[h2](EPIC RAID) Yhwach[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/f6694d7ad90d1c95ef96e7f7e4ef5a2d35d3a9bf.png[/img]

Available: 9/30 16:00 - 10/31 15:59 JST

Epic Raids are super-hard 6-player challenges. The boss for this Epic Raid is Yhwach.

[h2]Kon's Mega Bonanza[/h2]
Available: 9/30 00:00 - 10/16 23:59 JST

Available once a day, beating the boss in Kon's Mega Bonanza will earn you an automatic ★4 Power Heart, and other enemies drop lots of ★3 Power Hearts and Large EXP Crystals.

[h2]Rukia's Special Training: Extra[/h2]
Available: 9/30 00:00 - 10/16 23:59 JST

Rukia's Special Training: Extra is available once per day and gives out far more than the normal amount of character EXP. This is a great chance to earn EXP for powering up your characters.

[h2]Ururu & Jinta's Daily Free Gift Bonanza[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/f4ed5dc6af89d885cb9fc978f4315f1c0ddf27bd.png[/img]

Available: 10/16 16:00 - 10/31 15:59 JST

Ururu & Jinta's Daily Free Gift Bonanza is a special quest that is available once a day.

Clear the quest for a chance to earn Rainbow Link Slot Potions, ★4/★5 Summons Tickets, and other great rewards. Make sure to clear the quest every day so you don't miss out!

[h2]Tie-In Campaign Special Orders: Round 1[/h2]
Available: 9/30 16:00 - 10/16 15:59 JST

During the period shown above, Round 1 of the Tie-In Campaign Special Orders will be available.
Complete these special Orders to earn great rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/172099ba95b2139a5667b19f0c5560441af62970.png[/img]

Go to the Events tab in the Orders menu to see details of the other Special Orders.

[h2]Tie-In Campaign Special Orders: Round 2[/h2]
Available: 10/16 16:00 - 10/31 15:59 JST

During the period shown above, Round 2 of the Tie-In Campaign Special Orders will be available.
Complete these special Orders to earn great rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/43710b656416ff9c058112bdcedee57aca44def4.png[/img]

Go to the Events tab in the Orders menu to see details of the other Special Orders.

[h2]Social Network Post Orders[/h2]
Available: 9/30 16:00 - 10/16 15:59 JST

Orders relating to posting on social networks will be added to the Orders menu. Post on Twitter to earn 20 Spirit Orbs!

Not Available on PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5

[h2]Increased Power-Up Items[/h2]
Available: 9/30 16:00 - 10/31 15:59 JST

Get even more power-up items during the period shown above!
Get your hands on as many as you can to power up as many characters as you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/260adbfdfa183402485b7cecaaa77482e3cfcdef.png[/img]

[h2]October Login Bonuses[/h2]
Available: 10/1 00:00 - 10/31 23:59 JST

notes.content:
[b]Available: 7/23 16:00 - 7/31 15:59 JST[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/c6e16a439b31f35526a62550a74b3d3594d71e0e.png[/img]

Celebrate the 7th anniversary of Bleach: Brave Souls with the 7th Anniversary Step-Up Summons!

The 7th Anniversary Step-Up Summons comes in both single-pull and x10 types, and the first pull from both Summons is free! From Step 2 onward, each Step comes with extra bonus items, and Step 6 of the x10 Summons guarantees you one of the twelve featured ★5 characters.

There are seven Steps in total. The Steps do not reset, but you can use Step 7 as many times as you like.

This Summons features special 7th Anniversary versions of Ichigo and Uryu!

Ichigo Kurosaki, A shot to dispel the shadows!
Ichigo is a ranged strong attack character with the Soul Reaper Killer and Arrancar Killer abilities. All of his attacks have a chance to inflict Paralysis and Weaken, and he comes with the new Innate Skill Immobilizer + Enervator, which gives him a chance to inflict Paralysis and Weaken on nearby enemies at regular intervals. His second strong attack is a homing vortex that homes in on the nearest enemy while sucking in any other nearby enemies.He also has the new skill Shared Complete Status Immunity, which reduces the duration of inflicted status ailments to both Ichigo and his allies!

Ichigo has the Innate Skill Havoc (+20%) and can learn the Frenzy +1, Bombardment +1, and Status Ailment Spiritual Pressure Boost 80% skills. This makes him capable of destroying his enemies with powerful attacks. He can also increase the effect of his Reduced Strong Attack Cooldown Soul Trait to -14%. That's not all, though! He can also learn the Sharpshooter and Hit Hidden Enemies skills! This means that enemies cannot guard against any of his attacks, and they lose their ability to negate his ranged attacks!


Uryu Ishida, A flash of clarity!
Uryu is a melee strong attack character with the Arrancar Killer and No Affiliation Killer abilities. All of his attacks have a chance to inflict both Weaken and Drain, and his Special Move has a debuff effect.

Uryu also comes with the new "Gauge" feature: When this gauge is filled, Increased Strong Attack Damage +100% and Damage Taken -50% are activated for a fixed period of time. But that's not all! Uryu also comes with a new "Gauge Effect" skill, (Gauge Effect) Strong Attack Recharge -30%! When this Gauge Effect is activated the remaining time until you can use a strong attack again is reduced, making it easier to pummel your enemies with strong attacks!

Uryu can learn Frenzy +2 and Havoc (+20%) as well as the new skills Guard Break + Hit Hidden Enemies, Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Power Attribute Enemies, and (Team/Party) Increased Speed Attribute Character Strong Attack Damage. Make use of these to break through enemy guards and crush hidden enemies!

Uryu has Sprinter +2 and Long Stride, meaning that he's nimble on the battlefield and can bring the fight to his enemies in an instant!

See below for details.

notes.title: Version 14.0.1 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Bleach: Brave Souls! This notice contains information about the version 14.0.1 update.

[h2]Version 14.0.1 Update[/h2]

[h3]Soul Ticket Boost Settings[/h3]
The Use 5 Soul Tickets button on the Prepare for Quest screen of Sub Stories, Chronicle Quests, and events will be adjusted so that players can set the amount of tickets to be used. Players may choose to use between 1 and 10 tickets.

If a Brave Souls Bonanza Pass is active when 5 Soul Tickets are used, an extra ticket's worth of rewards will be received. Please be aware that some quests have a limit to the amount of times they can be cleared and the amount of Soul Tickets to be used cannot be set higher than this limit.

Please make use of this feature to use more Soul Tickets, and get more rewards, than before.

[h3]Character Filters Added[/h3]
Link Slots, Transcendence, and Character Power-Up Status have been added to the filter screen. These additions will allow players to apply more detailed filters.

We have also adjusted the display on the filter screen. This should make it easier to search for characters that are still in the process of being powered-up, as well as those without badges.

Some filters are still under development and cannot be used at the moment.

[h3]Room Rules and Kick Feature Added[/h3]

Room Rules can now be set for Co-Op Quests and Epic Raids.

Players will be able to set a room message, as well as preferences/limits for Player Rank, Brave Battle League, Level, Attribute, Transcendence level, Link Slot level, Skills, and Status Ailment Duration Reduction (80% or more). However, players cannot set limits on Player Rank, Brave Battle League, Transcendence level, or Link Slot level that are higher than their own.

If Room Rules have been set, the room owner can tap and hold on a character other than their own to see that player's details. From that screen they can also kick that player out of the room.

- When a skill has been set in the room rules, only characters with that exact skill currently activated will be able to enter the room.

Example: If the room rules have been set to allow characters with Reduced Strong Attack Cooldown to enter, those with only (Full Stamina Only) Reduced Strong Attack Cooldown will not be able to enter the room.

- Characters with skills activated through Character Links will be able to enter the room.

Example: If the room rules have been set to allow characters with Decreased Damage Taken and a character has activated that skill through a Character Link, they will be able to enter the room.

[h3]Account Deletion[/h3]

Players will now be able to request that their account be deleted from the Title screen menu. The account, and all associated data, will be permanently deleted two weeks after the request. Once deleted, there is no way to recover the deleted data.

[h3]Test Play Time Limit Adjustment[/h3]

The time limit on test playing a character will be changed from 30 seconds to 60 seconds. This additional time will allow players to make use of buffs, barriers, and other strong attacks with long cooldown times more than once.

[h3]Issues Fixed[/h3]

- When 5 Soul Tickets were used on Story Events, the Points shown on the Results screen were sometimes not shown as the boosted amount. This issue has now been fixed. This issue was purely cosmetic and the correct amount of Points was being received.

- Reduced the frequency of data download errors.

- Fixed an in-game issue wherein a member leaving a Co-Op Quest would result in the displayed order of characters on the Create Party and Player Info screens not matching.

We apologize for any inconvenience and hope you continue to enjoy the game.

notes.title: New Year's Campaign: Round 1
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Bleach: Brave Souls!

We have lots of great content lined up for the New Year's Campaign: Round 1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/ac14a8c0b9b15cd582964db31d4f14c17eb80e79.png[/img]

[h2]New Year Login Bonuses: Round 1[/h2]
Available: 1/1 00:00 - 1/17 23:59 JST
 
Log in every day for 15 days to receive a total of 75 Spirit Orbs! Make sure to log in every day so you don't miss out!

You can see a list of forthcoming login bonuses by tapping the cogwheel icon in the top right of the Home screen and then tapping the Login Bonus button.

[h2]New Year 2022 Choose a ★6 Summons[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/a661dd90db53dd5ae33d6e7acf269e90c065d3c9.png[/img]

Available: 12/31 16:00 - 1/31 15:59 JST

We have a Choose a ★6 Summons lined up to celebrate the start of 2022! This Summons is available for free once per player and is a great chance to get your hands on a sought-after character.

[h2]SAFWY Step-Up Summons: Untold Stories: Three[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/ac4e6612b43745ffd59953a3272fff686b0fba86.png[/img]

Available: 12/31 16:00 - 1/12 15:59 JST

New SAFWY Untold Stories version characters are here!

The SAFWY Step-Up Summons: Untold Stories: Three comes in both single-pull and x10 types, and the first pull from both Summons is free! From Step 2 onward, each Step comes with extra bonus items, and Step 6 of the x10 Summons guarantees you one of the twelve featured ★5 characters.

[h2]Untold Stories: Three[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/06b59c2d302ec3f8d4d2727bc28927b6f631b4b3.png[/img]

Available: 12/31 16:00 - 1/16 15:59 JST

One after another, people have been reporting the presence of a suspicious Spiritual Pressure in the Seireitei. One captain has sensed it there as well.

[h2]New Year 2022 Special Orders: Round 1[/h2]
Available: 12/31 16:00 - 1/16 15:59 JST

Complete these special Orders to earn great rewards.

[h2]Ururu & Jinta's Daily Free Gift Bonanza[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/f4ed5dc6af89d885cb9fc978f4315f1c0ddf27bd.png[/img]

Available:1/1 16:00 - 1/10 15:59 JST

Ururu & Jinta's Daily Free Gift Bonanza is a special quest that is available once a day.

Clear the quest for a chance to earn Rainbow Link Slot Potions, ★4/★5 Summons Tickets, and other great rewards. Make sure to clear the quest every day so you don't miss out!

[h2]Revival Candle Daily Rare Loot Quest[/h2]
Available: 12/31 00:00 - 1/15 23:59 JST

A special quest available once a day that guarantees a Revival Candle, which allows you to continue a quest without spending Spirit Orbs.

[h2]Rukia's Special Training: Extra[/h2]
Available: 1/1 00:00 - 1/15 23:59 JST

Rukia's Special Training: Extra is available once per day and gives out far more than the normal amount of character EXP. This is a great chance to earn EXP for powering up your characters.

[h2]Kon's Mega Bonanza[/h2]
Available: 12/31 00:00 - 1/15 23:59 JST

Available once a day, beating the boss in Kon's Mega Bonanza will earn you an automatic ★4 Power Heart, and other enemies drop lots of ★3 Power Hearts and Large EXP Crystals.

[h2]Increased Item Drops[/h2]
Available: 1/3 16:00 - 1/23 15:59 JST

Various resources will be easier to acquire during the campaign period. Use this chance to stock up on rare and valuable items.

[h2]January Login Bonuses[/h2]
Available: 1/1 00:00 - 1/31 23:59 JST

Login bonuses for January include a Choose a ★5 Frenzy Character Summons Ticket, The Hogyoku's Will, and loads of other great rewards.

[h2]Power-Up Festival[/h2]
Available: 1/4 16:00 - 1/31 15:59 JST

During the campaign, different resources for powering up characters and Accessories will be easier to acquire. Use this chance to stock up on rare and valuable items.

[h2]Social Network Post Orders[/h2]
Available: 12/31 16:00 - 1/12 15:59 JST

Post on Twitter and Facebook to earn up to 40 Spirit Orbs!

notes.title: 6th Anniversary Step-Up Summons
notes.content:
[h3]This Summons features the special 6th Anniversary version of Aizen!

Sosuke Aizen, without fear![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/a5240a296a97a6906868cc934fa26d0bdc6841fa.png[/img]

Aizen is a ranged strong attack character with the Soul Reaper Killer and Captain Killer abilities. He comes with the new "Dodge Soul Reaper Damage 50%" Innate Skill, which means he has a 50% chance to ignore all damage when being attacked by Soul Reapers. 

He is also the first character with attacks that have a chance of inflicting multiple status ailments. All of his attacks have a chance to inflict both Weaken and Drain! Add to this Frenzy +2, 20% Havoc, and a five-second Debilitator and you have a character who truly has the potential to stand at the top.

That's not all, though! As if Aizen wasn't formidable enough already, he can also unlock "Hit Hidden Enemies" and is only the second character ever capable of unlocking the "Sharpshooter" skill, which nullifies both ranged guard and Ranged Attack Resistance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/822a8f33c46f86df85d68d20071f18db43e35a4f.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=1-Er1XVgXZ4;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Dodge Soul Reaper Damage 50%[/h3]
This skill gives the character a percentage chance to ignore all damage from Soul Reapers' attacks. However, please note that this skill does not stack with other abilities or Accessories that grant a percentage change to ignore damage or ranged damage. This skill has no effect if the attacking character has a "Read Dodges" skill that matches the defending character's Affiliation.

[h3]Multiple Status Ailment-Inflicting Attacks[/h3]
These attacks have a chance of inflicting two different status ailments. When an attack successfully inflicts a status ailment, only one status ailment graphical effect will be displayed, but the effects of both status ailments will be inflicted at the same time.

If the defending character is resistant to one of the status ailments, only the status ailment that the character is not resistant to will be inflicted. If a character possesses the "Debilitator" or "Disabler" skills, or an "Increased Damage to Status Ailment-Affected Enemies" skill, these skills will affect both status ailments. Skills such as "Damage to Weakened Enemies" that only apply to one of the status ailments will still have an effect.

notes.title: Version 12.0.0 Update
notes.content:
Version 12.0.0 Update

New "Bonus Abilities" Function
We have added a new method of making your favorite characters even stronger than before. 

Bonus Abilities are extra abilities that you can choose for a character. You can set a maximum of two Bonus Abilities to each character. The first Bonus Ability slot unlocks when you power up all a character's Character Link slots to level 15, and the second Bonus Ability Slot unlocks when you power up all Character Link slots to level 20.

Bonus Abilities
One Bonus Ability can be set in each Bonus Ability slot. However, the same Bonus Ability cannot be set twice to the same character. Also, some Bonus Abilities have a limit to their maximum effectiveness. If the combined effect of a Bonus Ability and the maximum effect of any Soul Traits, Innate Abilities, and Skills a character can attain by fully upgrading their Soul Tree exceeds the limit for a given ability, the relevant Bonus Ability cannot be applied to that character.

We have identified an issue whereby a pop-up about unlocking Bonus Ability slots will mistakenly be displayed again when checking the Bonus Ability slots after Resurrecting a character that already had Bonus Ability slots unlocked.

We plan to fix this issue in a future update. Please note that this is only an error with the pop-up. Bonus Ability slots are still carried over to Resurrected characters.

Available Bonus Abilities

Bonus Abilities with Maximum Effect Limits

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/e9bbd09ef9dfc27fadb7206ed1518c746e6c3201.png[/img]
- Bonus Ability values listed as "Same as skill" have the same effect as the standard skill of the same name.
- Maximum limits indicated by numerals rather than percentages indicate how many times a character can have that ability. This is the combined number of Bonus Abilities as well as Soul Traits, Innate Skills, and Skills a character can attain by fully upgrading their Soul Tree. A Bonus Ability cannot be applied to a character if the result would exceed this limit.

Bonus Abilities without Maximum Effect Limits

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/87ed0e71247bfdd7142e6682f407290486196e01.png[/img]

Bonus Ability values listed as "Same as skill" have the same effect as the standard skill of the same name.

Character Link Slot Levels
The maximum Character Link slot level will be increased from 10 to 20. Increasing a Character Link slot level to level 20 will increase the stats the base character inherits from the linked character to 30%. Coins and Link Slot Potions, Super Link Slot Potions, and Droplets of the same Attribute as the base character are required to increase a link slot's level beyond ten. Super Link Slot Potions can be acquired from Inheritance Trials. 

Character Level Indicator
With the addition of level 20 Character Link slots, the character level color will now change when the character has three level 20 Character Link slots rather than three level 10 Character Links slots.

As a result, some characters' level indicators will change when the update is implemented. We also plan to make some adjustments to the character level indicator in a future update to make it easier to tell at a glance how far a character has been powered up.

Inheritance Trials
Inheritance Trials are time-limited high-difficulty quests. Some enemies in Inheritance Trials have the new "Iron Skin" ability, which means they suffer a reduced amount of damage from attacks. However, this effect is nullified when the enemy is suffering from a status ailment. You can check which enemies have the Iron Skin ability in the Rules section for a quest.

Inheriting Stats
Character Link slots of levels 11 through 20 will impart the following stat percentages to the base character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/478d5fef33acad9ec8f9e8158fa76a13c461d953.png[/img]

- Event specifications, availability times, and in-game balance are subject to change without notice.


New Quest Type
Inheritance Trials are new high-difficulty quests where you can acquire the materials you need to power up your characters' Character Link slots to level 20. Inheritance Trials come in both single-player and Co-Op varieties, each with their own special rules.

Adjustments to Dupe Character Rewards
We will be making some adjustments to the rewards players receive when pulling a duplicate character from a Summons. The adjustments to the rewards will be implemented at a later date. 

Adjustments to Quest Preparation Screens
Player selections such as stage rules tabs, special rules tabs, ally selections, and so on will now be saved independently for different quest preparations screens. Also, an "EQUIP!!!" alert will now be displayed if one or more characters in your selected team is not fully equipped with Accessories and Character Links.

Adjustment to Resurrection Trials
Resurrection Rings will now be slightly easier to obtain in Resurrection Trials.

Adjustments to Some Soul Trait and Accessory Descriptions
In order to differentiate Soul Trait and Accessory effects that previously used the word "dodge" from the recently added Dodge ability that some enemies possess, we have altered some text so that Soul Traits and Accessories that give a percentage chance to ignore all damage from attack will now use the word "evasion." Please note that this is just a change in the wording. No change has been made to the effect of these Soul Traits or Accessories.

Issues Fixed
- Players not being matched with AI opponents in Brave Battle leagues Seat 8 to Seat 10.

We apologize for any inconvenience and hope you continue to enjoy the game.

notes.title: The Machine Society Summons: Magic and Steam
notes.content:
New characters from the steampunk world of the Machine Society are here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/6d9305268cb3ee76d75e16a4d0f57bd11fbed5c1.png[/img]

[h1]Yoruichi Shihoin[/h1]
[previewyoutube=zGakcJEPJDQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Yoruichi is a melee strong attack character with the Hollow Killer ability. She comes with both the "Read Hollow Dodges" and "Poison Immunity" Innate Abilities built in at ★5. All of her attacks apart from her second strong attack have a chance to inflict Burn, which combines excellently her 20% Havoc, Frenzy, two-second Debilitator, and Guard Break skills. She is also a useful support character as her second strong attack is a Boost move that can be upgraded by unlocking her Enhancer skill.

[h1]Nemu Kurotsuchi[/h1]
[previewyoutube=3gf3jNvuPYI;full][/previewyoutube]
Nemu is a ranged strong attack character with the Hollow Killer ability, and she comes with the "Freeze Immunity" Innate Ability built in at ★5. All of her attacks have a chance to inflict Paralysis. Combined with her Frenzy, Havoc, and five-second Debilitator skills, plus a charged third strong attack, this gives her the potential to deal significant damage against opponents who are unable to fight back. She can also unlock "Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Speed Attribute Hollows," which greatly increases her chance of inflicting Paralysis to Speed Attribute Hollows. Finally, she can also unlock the "(Team/Party) Technique Attribute Soul Reaper Strong Attack Damage +20%" skill that increases the strong attack damage for any Technique Attribute Soul Reapers in the same Team or Party as Nemu by 20%. (Please note that the "(Team/Party) Technique Attribute Soul Reaper Strong Attack Damage +20%" skill does not stack if you have more than one character with the same skill in a team or party.) 

"Increased Status Ailment Chance Against Speed Attribute Hollows" and "(Team/Party) Technique Attribute Soul Reaper Strong Attack Damage +20%" will be the Nemu's Attainable Skills list at a later date.

[h1]Mashiro Kuna[/h1]
[previewyoutube=b9SzyjhGqcw;full][/previewyoutube]
Mashiro is a ranged strong attack character with the Arrancar Killer ability. All of her attacks have a chance to inflict Weaken, which combines excellently with her 20% Havoc, five-second Debilitator, and Reduced Strong Attack Cooldown -12% skills. She can also unlock Guard Break and the new Increased Mind Droplet Drop +17% skill, making her a very useful character for farming.

These new characters will be added to the Epic Raid Advantage character list of the Shrieker Awakened Epic Raid and as bonus characters for The Machine Society: The Key of Magic event.

The EXP and Coins in Kon's Bonanza will be doubled while The Machine Society Summons: Magic and Steam is available, so you will be able to easily power up any new characters you are lucky enough to pull.

Increased Mind Droplet Drop
This skill increases the number of Mind Droplets the character acquires during quests. This skill is triggered when the character is included in a team. The effect of this skill stacks if multiple characters with the same skill are included in a team in both single-player quests and Co-Op quests.

Please note that the effects of this skill do not pass on to the base character when a character with this skill is used as a link. The effects of this skill also do not trigger if a character with this skill is taken along on a quest as an ally.

notes.title: Fierce Battle Summons: Carnival of Conflict
notes.content:
[h1]This Summons features new versions of characters involved in the epic battles of the Hueco Mundo story arc.[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/04b8ecf250eb9f0b0216dd22aef76a3e4d73c006.png[/img]

[h1]Uryu Ishida[/h1]
[previewyoutube=74oZZFqxwKM;full][/previewyoutube]
Uryu is a ranged strong attack character with the Arrancar Killer ability. His unlockable skills include Frenzy and 40% Berserker, and he can also increase the effect of his Reduced Strong Attack Cooldown Soul Trait to -14%. He is also able to unlock both Guard Break and Hit Hidden Enemies, meaning there is little chance for enemies to avoid his strong attack barrage!



[h1]Renji Abarai[/h1]
[previewyoutube=LVTO0679SoY;full][/previewyoutube]
Renji is a melee normal attack character with the Espada Killer ability.
All of his normal and strong attacks have a chance to inflict Lacerate and his Special Move inflicts Burn. His unlockable skills include Flurry, a two-second Debilitator, and Damage to Lacerated Enemies +40%. His second strong attack surrounds him in a vortex that continuously damages nearby enemies, and he can also unlock the "(Team/Party) Heart Attribute Soul Reaper Normal Attack Damage +20% " skill that increases the normal attack damage for any Heart Attribute Soul Reapers in the same Team or Party as Renji by 20%! (Please note that the "(Team/Party) Heart Attribute Soul Reaper Normal Attack Damage +20%" skill does not stack if you have more than one character with the same skill in a team or party.)

[h1]Szayelaporro[/h1]
[previewyoutube=5KE70VF6mLc;full][/previewyoutube]
Szayelaporro is a ranged strong attack character with the new Quincy Killer ability. All of his attacks have a chance to inflict Poison, which is made even more deadly by the fact that he can unlock Damage to Poisoned Enemies +20% and a two-second Debilitator. His second strong attack is a static vortex, and his unlockable skills include 20% Berserker, and Frenzy. He is also the first character in a long time to come with the Increased Crystal/Jewel Drop Soul Trait, making him a useful character for farming power-up materials. Finally, he is also able to unlock Paralysis Immunity, making him very useful on quests with a lot of Paralysis inducing enemies or hazards.

These new characters will be added to the Epic Raid Advantage character list of the Shrieker Epic Raid and as bonus characters for the Soul Eater event.

The EXP and Coins in Kon's Bonanza will be doubled while the Fierce Battle Summons: Carnival of Conflict is available, so you will be able to easily power up any new characters you are lucky enough to pull.

notes.title: Ver. 11.3 Update
notes.content:
We have made a number of improvements to Brave Battles teams with the version 11.3 update, including new rewards and an improved team editing process.

We hope you continue to enjoy the game.

Updates

Medal Exchange
- Increased exchange amounts for some items.
- Reduced Rare Medal costs for some items.
- ★5 Summons Tickets, Link Slot Potions, ★4 Hachigen, and ★4 Nemu added to the Exchange.
- ★1 Power Hearts removed, ★3 Power Hearts added.

Ranking Rewards
- Increased Rare Medal rewards for all leagues.
- For all leagues, the attainable tickets will be unified to Brave Souls Summons Tickets and Brave Souls Accessory Tickets, and we will make adjustments to the number of tickets attainable.
- Adjustments to the reward bands for ranking positions. (This adjustment will only affect reward bands and there will be no adjustment to the promotion and demotion zones.)

Team Editing
- The Brave Battle team editing process will now be the same as that for Co-Op Quests and Epic Raids, with separate teams for Brave Battles.
- Up to 10 Brave Battle teams can be created.

notes.title: Version 11.2 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Bleach: Brave Souls! This notice contains information about the version 11.2 update.

We have made some adjustments to the Packs screen and added the ability to view notices related to Packs from the same screen.

We have added a "Skills" topic to the Strategy menu. The Strategy menu can be found at the bottom of the News screen.

Changes to Loading Screens
We have made some adjustments to the loading screens that show character details.

We hope you continue to enjoy the game.

notes.title: Thousand-Year Blood War Summons: Heart & Fire
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420935/2f3a87e6bfd8ae29480feecba70181c8b1c65a42.png[/img]

More characters from the Thousand-Year Blood War are here to show their true power!

[b]Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto[/b]
Genryusai is a melee strong attack character with the No Affiliation Killer ability. He is the first character to come with new "Innate Abilities." He has three Innate Abilities: "Immolator," which gives him a chance to inflict Burn on nearby enemies every five seconds, "Read No Affiliation Dodges," and Fire Immunity. All of his attacks also have a chance to inflict Burn, and he can unlock 20% Berserker, 20% Havoc, and a two-second Debilitator. Rounding out his total mastery of fire is Damage to Burning Enemies +20%, meaning that in the highly likely event of his enemies being on fire, he deals even more damage.

[b]Chojiro Tadaoki Sasakibe[/b]
Chojiro is a melee strong attack character with the Captain Killer ability. All of his attacks have a chance to inflict Paralysis, which is made even more deadly by the fact that he can unlock Damage to Paralyzed Enemies +20% and a five-second Debilitator. He can also unlock 20% Havoc and Frenzy, further increasing his chance of inflicting Paralysis. Finally, his Special Move wreaths him in lightning for a short time that damages enemies and also inflicts Paralysis.

[b]Izuru Kira[/b]
Izuru is a ranged normal attack character with the Hollow Killer ability. All of his attacks have a chance to inflict Weaken, and his unlockable skills include Flurry, 30% Bruiser, a five-second Debilitator, Poise, and Last Ditch Survival. That's not all, though! He can also increase his Decreased Damage Taken Soul Trait to -20%!

These new characters will be added to the Epic Raid Advantage character list of the Kenpachi Epic Raid and as bonus characters for Thousand-Year Blood War Pieces: Life and Death event.

The EXP and Coins in Kon's Bonanza will be doubled while the Thousand-Year Blood War Summons: Heart & Fire is available, so you will be able to easily power up any new characters you are lucky enough to pull.

Innate Abilities
Innate Abilities are skills that come built in to ★5 characters and automatically trigger when the character is in use. However, they cannot be passed onto other characters through Character Link slots. You can see what Innate Abilities a character has by checking the character's Details screen.

Immolator
Gives a percentage chance to inflict Burn on nearby enemies every few seconds.

- Immolator only inflicts the Burn status ailment and does not cause damage with the initial "hit" in the way that status-ailment inducing attacks do.
- This Innate Ability only has an effect when the character is the active character.
- Immolator has no effect when a character is at zero Stamina or is reviving.

Read No Affiliation Dodges
This skill allows the character to hit No Affiliation enemies with the Dodge ability or No Affiliation characters with the Dodge Soul Trait when either the ability or the Soul Trait activates.

notes.title: Version 11.1 Update
notes.content:
Steam Version Key Config
We have added the ability to alter the key configuration for the Steam version.

New Accessories
We have added three new Accessories. See the "New Accessories coming with version 11.1" notice in-game for more details.

Adjustments to Using 5 Soul Tickets for Co-Op
For Co-Op Quest room owners, the setting for using 5 Soul Tickets will now carry over from your previous run for the same quest. 

Adjustments to the Treatment of Lost Connections During Co-Op
Soul Tickets will no longer be consumed if your connection is lost on a Co-Op Quest loading screen. Also, if the room owner's connection is lost while the quest is loading, you will now have the option to retire without losing any Soul Tickets as soon as the quest starts. However, if your connection is lost during a Co-Op Quest, any spent Soul Tickets will still be consumed.

We hope you continue to enjoy the game.
